verdict.rationale: Bento documents a bulk POST /batch/subscribers endpoint that creates or updates 1–1000 subscribers per request, plus a batch events API that updates profile fields. Custom fields can be set via the API, so create and update with custom properties at batch scale is covered. Suppression is not shown: the only related items are a filter on unsubscribe times and an anonymization/deletion endpoint, which is a different action. Missing for 10: a documented API to suppress or unsubscribe contacts, rate-limit or throughput documentation for production scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
